newsitem.title: CHINA: China Zhenhai '96 profits 850 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China Zhenhai '96 profits 850 mln yuan.

text.p: Profits of China's Zhenhai Refining and Chemical Co Ltd hit 850 million yuan in 1996, the Economic Information Daily said on Friday.
The newspaper did not say whether the figures were pre-tax, but China usually gives a pre-tax figure. It did not give comparative figures.
Zhenhai's profits rose by an average of 46.69 percent in the 1991-1995 period, it said.
The company owns and operates a refinery complex in Zhejiang province south of Shanghai.
Zhenhai managed to cut costs by 200 million yuan by adjusting production structure when international crude prices soared in 1996, the newspaper said, but gave no further details.
